IMMERSE YOURSELF
IN
INTERACTIVE INSTALLATIONS
From the primal heartbeat heard in the womb to the music shaped by the voice, the hands, and the body, sound is rooted in our very essence. This year, the KIKK Festival explores the world of sound and the deep relationship between rhythm, vibration, and life itself. Rhythm is an invisible force running through all living forms, from the beating of the heart to the murmurs of nature. It is the pulse of existence, woven into matter, plants, animals, and the smallest organisms.
BOOM BOOM TCHAK

The festival traces the evolution of sound, from its natural origins to its contemporary transformations, and questions how artificial intelligence and engineering are reshaping the way we listen and connect to the world. We dive into the realm of waves, resonances, and feedback loops, where sound meets rituals, traditions, and shared imagination.

Universal and primal, sound connects us across cultures, evoking mystical experiences and altered states of consciousness. Boom boom tchak, a fundamental rhythmic pattern found in many forms of music, embodies the dialogue between bass and snare, that pulse which drives motion and dance.
In this edition, we celebrate this universal rhythm as a bridge between the organic and the synthetic, the ancestral and the future. The exhibition invites you to listen, to feel, and to perceive the infinite harmonies of the world.

Marie du Chastel, artistic director of KIKK festival

An art journey throughout Namur

During the KIKK Festival, the city transforms into an open-air museum filled with interactive, digital art installations across iconic locations. A fun and immersive experience for families and curious minds of all ages—don’t miss this autumn highlight!

From October 23th to 26th, 2025, 10am-6pm
Late-night opening on Friday, October 24th, 6pm-10pm
Suitable for children and people with reduced mobility.
